description.value: 2% Jazz is a Victoria institution that has been roasting and serving specialty coffee since 1996, operating a cafe in Midtown Court on Hillside Avenue alongside a dedicated roastery in Central Saanich. The shop is known for ethically sourced beans roasted in-house, producing balanced and varied flavour profiles that have built a loyal local following. The business also pioneered affordable compostable cups, making them accessible to small independent cafes across Canada.
